# Triage process completion

Complete the reviewed triage process with a retained decision, or an explicit declared rejection, review or needs-input outcome.

- Project: assess fit against the selected Project goals and rules, and assess authorized duplicate candidates. Retain bounded reasons, consumed evidence, search scope and coverage. Missing context or unresolved judgments remain unresolved and follow the reviewed gate.
- Systems analyst: run only after the accepted eligible Project handoff. Retain the original ticket and assess its priority, kind, size, component, severity, risk, dependencies and recommended route within the configured vocabulary.
- For defects, distinguish preliminary reproducibility from independently verified reproduction evidence bound to the exact subject, environment and command attempt. Missing tools, timeouts, dependency failures, model prose or a generic nonzero exit do not prove non-reproduction. Features may declare reproduction not applicable.
- Retain stage/Profile/context provenance and the exact completion document version and digest. Separate observed facts, assessments and unresolved information; preserve missing ticket details instead of inventing them.
- Request only explicitly configured accepted local-status and GitHub effects. Keep the accepted decision and local status separate from pending, failed or confirmed provider delivery. A missing delivery receipt must not be presented as a successful write.

These are criteria for completing triage, not ticket-authored implementation acceptance. They do not certify a fix, fill missing Issue acceptance, or authorize another implementation, PR or delivery pipeline.
